summary: Provides the core application modules for building directory concepts, generating and rendering structured documentation and README files, performing package analysis, and handling domain-specific errors.
responsibilities: Manages directory concept construction and build results.
Handles core workflows for document generation, translation, rendering, and construction.
Defines domain-specific error classes and phase classifications for conceptual operations.
Performs package analysis, concept building, dependency collection, and path processing.
Orchestrates the generation and configuration of project README documentation files.
relationships: The readme generation process utilizes context initialization, definitions, and child packages for building and rendering documentation files.
Document generation relies on document context initialization, models, builders, translation, and rendering components.
ConceptError relates to ConceptPhase to classify errors during conceptual execution.
Package analysis and package concept generation utilize internal package utilities to support operations.
The build module uses types defined in the types module to represent build outcomes.
design_decisions: Modular organization separating core business logic domains like directory concepts, document handling, error definitions, package analysis, and readme generation into distinct subdirectories.
